newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: AND TO PAY FIRST DIVIDEND ON 1998 RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: AND TO PAY FIRST DIVIDEND ON 1998 RESULTS.

text.p: Rotterdam-based AND International Publishers said on Thursday it expected to pay its first dividend over 1998 results.
"Profits will be retained until it is commercially prudent to pay dividends and that it is not expected before 1998," AND said at a press presentation to mark its Amsterdam bourse debut.
AND, listed on London's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) since July, said its 1996 results were developing in line with those of the electronic publishing sector as a whole.
The company declined to make a precise forecast for full-year 1996 earnings but said it made a pre-tax profit of 755,000 guilders on revenues of 8.4 million in the first half.
Finance director Eiko Dekkers said the bulk of AND's revenues and earnings were traditionally generated in the second half of the year.
"December is an important month for us. Traditionally, the biggest part of our sales and results are generated in the second half of the year," he said.
For the whole of 1995 AND made a pre-tax profit of 1.37 million guilders on revenues of 15.1 million.
